name: eevee-light-shader-fast-path
purpose: Verify the Eevee Light Shader fast paths added for uniform light shader results, Shader to RGB front-layer point-dependent cache, and point-dependent surface texture layer overflow fallback.
passCriteria: The test must render uniform custom light shader results with Range Scale kept at 1 through deferred, forward, and volume paths; render a Light Space checker through Shader to RGB using the front-layer cache; create more point-dependent custom light shaders than the GPU texture-layer limit and verify the render completes with the custom surface path safely disabled instead of crashing.
